         **Review examples:**
            1. _315-OTS_, Nov 21, 2026, 1/5: "But it’s hindering more than helping. The sloooowness and bugs need to be fix l ASAP. I liked the set up not the (frustrating) operations."

            3. _frostypond_, Nov 24, 2026, 4/5: "This app is super helpful for people who forget everything. I love that it can pick up stuff from your calendars and add them automatically. My only complaint is that the time picker consistently doesn't make sense. I don't get why I can't just type in the time. Sometimes I have events that are not at the precise pre-set times it wants but the detailed time picker is very buggy. For example I want to set an event from 8 am to 12 pm but it keeps interpreting it as 23 hours rather than 4 hours for some reason so it changes 12 pm to 12 am the next day. I face this issue a lot and it's my only recurring frustration."
